hypotheses.C0_exact_read_vectors_recover_mode_coeff: Weight-derived state read vectors reproduce discovery coefficients of the first 64 operator modes with relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.C1_layer16_spike_is_a_common_operator: Layer 16's frozen discovery-mean operator has FineWeb fidelity at least 0.60 and its leading uncentered mode has cosine at least 0.95 with that mean.
hypotheses.C2_layer16_variation_remains_spectrally_: After subtracting the discovery mean operator, Layer 16's leading centered mode still carries at least 0.25 of variation energy.
hypotheses.C3_layer16_leading_mode_is_a_simple_matr: The leading Layer-16 operator mode needs at most rank 4 between the 32D input chart and 1,152D output to retain 90% of its energy.
hypotheses.C4_layer16_mode_family_is_inner_low_rank: The energy-weighted median matrix rank-90 among the first 64 Layer-16 modes is at most 8.
hypotheses.C5_rank4_inner_factorization_preserves_t: At every layer and corpus, truncating each of 64 modes to matrix rank 4 loses at most 0.05 fidelity relative to the complete 64-mode atlas.
hypotheses.C6_layer16_has_a_compact_read_transform_: The exact-read, 64-mode, inner-rank-4 program retains at least 0.80 fidelity at Layer 16 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C7_earlier_layers_remain_broad_after_ten: At least one of Layers 13--15 remains below 0.70 fidelity even with 64 modes and inner rank 8 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C8_exact_read_program_matches_oracle_pro: With full inner rank, exact weight-derived reads reproduce rank-64 oracle projection within 1e-5 fidelity at every layer and corpus.
